'''FK Grobiņa''' is a [[Latvia]]n [[association football|football]] club based in [[Grobiņa]] and plays in the first tier of Latvian football, the [[Latvian Higher League]] and the [[Latvian Football Cup]].
The club was founded as '''Grobiņas SC''' (short for '''Grobiņas sporta centrs,''' {{lang|en|Grobiņa Sports Center}}) in 2009.

In 2016 Grobiņas SC won the [[Latvian Second League]] Kurzeme Regional League and therefore qualified for the 2nd League final tournament which they won as well (beating SK Cēsis in finals) and with that earning promotion to [[Latvian First League|First League]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.tautasfutbols.lv/lff/grobinas-sc-triumfe-2-liga/ |title="Grobiņas SC" triumfē 2.Līgā – Tautas futbols |access-date=2018-02-17 |archive-date=2017-05-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170507194004/http://www.tautasfutbols.lv/lff/grobinas-sc-triumfe-2-liga/ |url-status=dead }}</ref> In their First League debut season they achieved 4th place.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.liepajniekiem.lv/sports/futbols/pirma-liga/debijas-sezonu-pabeidza-4-vieta-210685|title=Debijas sezonu pabeidza 4. Vietā|access-date=2018-02-18|archive-date=2018-08-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180827044037/https://www.liepajniekiem.lv/sports/futbols/pirma-liga/debijas-sezonu-pabeidza-4-vieta-210685|url-status=dead}}</ref>

From 2022 to mid-2024 the club had a cooperation agreement with the [[FK Liepāja]] youth academy (''Liepājas futbola skola''), thus having regular players joining/getting loaned from Liepāja and having the prefix '''LFS''' next to their name.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.liepajniekiem.lv/sports/futbols/grobinas-futbols-un-pirma-liga-gaida-licenci-konsultes-dobrecovs-sadarbosies-ar-fk-liepaja-198226|title=Grobiņas futbols un pirmā līga – gaida licenci, konsultēs Dobrecovs, sadarbosies ar FK "Liepāja"|access-date=2018-02-18|archive-date=2018-06-14|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180614044748/https://www.liepajniekiem.lv/sports/futbols/grobinas-futbols-un-pirma-liga-gaida-licenci-konsultes-dobrecovs-sadarbosies-ar-fk-liepaja-198226|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 2025, the club was renamed FK Grobiņa."}}
